note: Eight disposable native K3s fixtures cover CLI/Helm, namespace/cluster scope and amd64/arm64. The predecessor uses actual published assets. Interruptions, native fresh builds and retained OCI readback pass. Independent future binaries add schema 7 and populate optional Image, native build-journal and provenance fields, then return to unchanged baseline binaries. The newer shared CRDs and opaque data remain, unsupported existing/fresh Images pause before building, published roots serve and unrelated Images build. Four Argo CD cases also round-trip actual published 0.6.0 charts and the synthetic future writer with interrupted provisioner/helper recovery. Synthetic schemas are confined to disposable APIs. Real mixed-cluster and actual publication checks are recorded separately.
